
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/nijunyang/p/19165578" title="发布于 2025-11-01 17:15">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">k8s-应用部署和组件及常用命令(2)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="syldJ"><span class="ne-text">1、相关组件介绍：</span></h3>
<p id="u8e28f888" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">node是k8s的集群节点，和实际的机器对应</span></p>
<p id="u2ccdf891" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">pod是应用容器，不同的应用部署在不同的pod中，k8s协调资源，将pod部署到集群中的node节点上（非master节点）。</span></p>
<p id="u82412b35" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">同时pod又是挂在namespace下面的，命名空间之间互相隔离。</span></p>
<p id="ub0374f12" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">pause 管理多个应用容器：搭建k8s集群的时候有一个镜像名字就是 <span class="ne-text">registry.k8s.io/pause:3.9</span></span></p>
<p id="u42fe0960" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">label 大规模管理pod</span></p>
<p id="u26944f9d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">volume: 挂载应用数据，应用产生的数据（如日志）和应用配置数据(如configMap)</span></p>
<p id="udb2951c9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">deployment ： 应用部署管理：rs副本管理 </span></p>
<p id="u7964ed1c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">service/ingress: 应用访问，对外开放tcp、http、https</span></p>
<p id="u7392f988" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">flannel: 节点间的网络访问的解决方案。我们部署时采用的这个，也有其他的</span></p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="wnvi5"><span class="ne-text">2、常用操作指令</span></h3>
<p id="u7daaf22c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl -h</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看命令信息：</span></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251025164015446-1446091485.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u2e0f01c9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">具体命令的使用和参数也可以使用 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl 命令 -h</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看</span></span></p>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<h4 id="yL7IO"><span class="ne-text">2.1 get 查看</span></h4>
<p id="ufa59c417" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get -h</span></code></span></p>
<p id="u22487c70" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看资源：get </span></p>
<p id="ua53bd2f3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看node:</span></p>
<p id="u0ca29eb1" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get nodes</span></code></p>
<p id="uecd86680" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看命名空间：</span></p>
<p id="uc2696a29" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get ns</span></code></p>
<p id="u56dd8101" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看pod：</span></p>
<p id="u15480da6" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get pods -A</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看所有命名空间的pod</span></p>
<p id="u2e7b80d8" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get pods -n 命名空间</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看指定命名空间的pod</span></p>
<p id="u00c144ce" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get pods -n kube-system</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看kube-system命名空间的pod</span></p>
<p id="u287a0482" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 id="fOpZV"><span class="ne-text">2.2、创建pod的方式</span></h4>
<p id="u76d69b5c" class="ne-p"><strong>1.命令模式 run</strong></p>
<p id="u57da97aa" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl run -h</span></code><span class="ne-text">` 查看命令使用</span></p>
<p id="u0c36e1de" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubectl run NAME --image=image [--env="key=value"] [--port=port] [--dry-run=server|client] [--overrides=inline-json]<br><span class="ne-text">[--command] -- [COMMAND] [args...] [options]</span></span></p>
<p id="u089918cc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们使用之前自己做的那个nginx镜像来创建一个nginx。</span></p>
<p id="uc701421b" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl run my-nginx --image=k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1</span></code></p>


</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251025164807065-778077841.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uaef64108" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl describe pod my-nginx</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看my-nginx 详细信息</span></p>
<p id="udcd2320b" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl logs my-nginx</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 查看my-nginx 日志</span></p>
<p id="ucb55fc49" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl exec -it my-nginx -- bin/bash</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 进入容器内部进行交互操作 进入容器之后<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">curl localhost</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 可以看到nginx的页面内容 exit 退出容器内部交互</span></span></p>
<p id="uc31a429e" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get pods</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 不指定命名空间，默认使用是default</span></p>
<p id="uec239a6c" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get pods -o wide</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 输出一些扩展信息</span></p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251025165027194-422502420.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ubb93203f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里有个ip，这个ip就是这个pod在k8s中的ip，去到k8s的其他节点都能访问：<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">curl 10.244.1.2</span></code></span></p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202510/1216484-20251025170044887-1632572793.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u0b7058b9" class="ne-p"><strong>2.yaml资源清单方式</strong></p>
<p id="u1047b288" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u82d57fab" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl get pod my-nginx -o yaml</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 以yaml方式查看资源信息，，这个是一个实际的状态而k8s就是负责资源预期状态到实际状态。</span></p>
<p id="uf9dba768" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl run my-nginx --image=k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1 --dry-run=client -o yaml</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 获取这个资源创建的预期状态，--dry-run 不会实际执行。</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101091922768-831061765.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u02c8e229" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kind: Pod</span></code><span class="ne-text">：说明这个 YAML 文件定义的是一个 Pod 资源</span></p>
<p id="u82b2406b" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl run my-nginx --image=k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1 --dry-run=client -o yaml &gt; nginx.yaml</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 把内容写到资源清单文件中去，用这个文件来创建资源</span></p>
<p id="u6d161b8d" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl apply -f nginx.yaml</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 以资源清单方式创建资源</span></p>
<p id="u43d15cab" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 id="n0Pcg"><span class="ne-text">2.3 deployment 应用部署管理器</span></h4>
<p id="u30a2b3a3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">deployment 应用部署管理器，让应用向预期状态靠近，比如 RS 副本管理，pod数量少了，就会自动帮你启动到设置数量。</span></p>
<p id="u53154852" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">创建 deployment </span></p>
<p id="ua417eaba" class="ne-p"><strong>命令方式</strong><span class="ne-text">：<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl create deployment</span></code></span></p>
<p id="u9d7144dc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubectl create deployment NAME --image=image -- [COMMAND] [args...] [options]</span></p>
<p id="u4bbc5971" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl create deployment my-nginx-deploment --image=k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1</span></code></p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101103752511-1248283374.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u52692b82" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">pod和deployment 还有rs 都创建好了</span></p>
<p id="u5334d4fe" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">名字也有层级关系：deployment名字-RS名字-pod名字</span></p>
<p id="uc8393f45" class="ne-p"><strong>资源清单方式：</strong></p>
<p id="u12fb9502" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl create deployment my-nginx-deploment --image=k8s-harbor.taoyao.com/nijunyang/my-nginx:1.29.1 --dry-run=client -o yaml &gt; my-nginx-deploment.yaml</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 把内容写到资源清单文件中去，用这个文件来创建资源</span></p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101104150676-274308473.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ufff27769" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">&nbsp;replicas 副本数改成2</span></p>
<p id="u5c647bff" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl apply -f my-nginx-deploment.yaml</span></code></p>
<p class="ne-p">直接就启动了两个pod</p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101104633739-567724320.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h4 id="WYrnD"><strong>2.4 资源对象扩缩容：</strong></h4>
<p id="uc62927b2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">edit：直接在现有的资源上修改属性 </span></p>
<p id="u8651accd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">scale：直接动态调整数量</span></p>
<p id="u86c4e08e" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl edit deployments.apps my-nginx-deploment</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 和vim操作一样 i 编辑模式 :wq 退出保存</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>

</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101105136577-1031868968.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>修改为三个，保存之后k8s自动给我们调整为了三个</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101105312243-108075846.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uc6159b33" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kubectl scale [--resource-version=version] [--current-replicas=count] --replicas=COUNT (-f FILENAME | TYPE NAME)<br><span class="ne-text">[options]</span></span></p>
<p id="u8aba836e" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u31f405bc" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">kubectl scale deployment my-nginx-deploment --replicas 5</span></code><span class="ne-text">   设置为5个</span></p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>


</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1216484/202511/1216484-20251101105945621-1056741246.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;基本也就差不多了，其他资源的创建方式也差不多，命令和yaml文件清单，推荐用文件方式。多使用帮助信息看看，再加上问AI，就差不多了</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
